descriptions.description: Note: Grant & Zijlstra (in Selbyana 19: 96. 1998) argue that B. karatas is the generitype, the choice having been made by Regel (in Gartenflora 17: 67. 1868) which therefore pre-dates the choice of B. pinguin made by Hitchcock (Prop. Brit. Bot.: 144. 1929). See discussion of the species name by Smith (in Phytologia 15: 173. 1967) who noted that Linnaeus' " panicula diffusa " is not shown by the cited Plumier element to which the name had long been attached. Espejo-Serna & al. (in Selbyana 25: 39. 2004) indicated " C. Plumier s. n. (LINN) " as the holotype but there is no such material present in LINN.
Generitype of Bromelia Linnaeus (vide Regel, Gartenflora 17: 67. Mar 1868).
Original material: [icon] in Plumier, Nov. Pl. Amer.: 10, t. 33. 1703.
